summary: Enbridge Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting a bought-deal public offering of common shares under its effective US shelf registration and Canadian short-form base shelf prospectus. On September 10, 2026, the company entered an underwriting agreement with a syndicate led by RBC Dominion Securities Inc. and CIBC World Markets Inc. for 38,900,000 common shares at CDN$66.85 per share; the over-allotment option for 5,835,000 additional shares was exercised in full. Aggregate gross proceeds were approximately CDN$3.0 billion. Closing occurred September 14, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
